title: WebExtension with slash-only all-site access and executable CSP escapes
intent: Equivalent slash-only match patterns and executable CSP directives must not bypass browser-specific findings.

stagedFiles.textSample:
{
  "manifest_version": 3,
  "name": "Alternate source helper",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "browser_specific_settings": { "gecko": { "id": "alternate-source-helper@example.invalid" } },
  "host_permissions": ["https://*/"],
  "content_scripts": [{ "matches": ["*://*/"], "js": ["content.js"] }],
  "content_security_policy": "script-src 'self'; script-src-elem https://cdn.example.invalid; worker-src blob:"
}
